text: Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: Frames 21.0 to 21.8 s. The same close side view continues. Hazard lamps blink at both ends in alternating frames, the car stays put in the water with a reflection, background blurred. Caption present until 21.2 s and gone from 21.4 s. The shot is the third consecutive second of this single static composition with only blinking lamps and ripples changing.
